query: INSERT INTO chat_invocations(id,run_id,thread_id,agent_id,status,started_at,ended_at,lease_expires_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,CASE WHEN $5<>'pending' THEN $6::timestamptz END,CASE WHEN $5 IN ('stopped','failed','canceled') THEN $6::timestamptz END,$7) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,ended_at=EXCLUDED.ended_at,lease_expires_at=EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at;
